verdict.rationale: Epic's license page explicitly lists "Access to the source code" across all platforms and features. A community member independently confirms Unreal "has source code included", and another describes building the engine itself as part of a AAA workflow. The probe shows the GitHub repo is EULA/account-gated rather than public, which is an access caveat, not a contradiction. missing for 10: first-party docs on obtaining, building and modifying the engine source, explicit terms for modifying and distributing engine changes, and hands-on corroboration of patching the engine itself.
